info.title: TWIN-ER API
info.description:
The HTTP API behind the TWIN-ER web app: run earthquake and flood scenarios,
then read their results by area, as map tiles, or as GeoJSON.

## How it fits together

1. **Run a scenario.** `GET /scenarios/fault` (a fault's maximum-magnitude
   earthquake), `POST /scenarios/manual` (an earthquake you define) or
   `POST /scenarios/flood`. The response has a `scenario_id` and one row of
   figures per affected municipality.
2. **Read the details** with that id: per-census-section figures, affected
   critical infrastructure, intensity bands (`/results/{scenario_id}/...`),
   and building/debris vector tiles (`/tiles/{scenario_id}/...`).

Scenario ids are content-addressed: the same inputs on the same data and
code version give the same id, so results can be cached and shared.

## Deployments

- **Local** (`bin/twiner start`): every route below, on one server.
- **Cloud** (AWS Lambda function URLs): the scenario function serves every
  route except `/tiles/...`, which a separate tiles function serves, and the
  two local-only routes `/results/{scenario_id}/status` and
  `/results/{scenario_id}/municipality_stats`.

There is no authentication, versioning guarantee or rate limit yet: this
reference describes the API the web app uses, not a stable public contract.

## Errors

The local server answers errors as `{"detail": "..."}`; the Lambda as
`{"error": "..."}`.

See the [twinQUAKE](/docs/hazards/earthquake/) and
[twinFLOOD](/docs/hazards/flood/) pages for what the numbers mean.

post.description: Simulates an earthquake you define: epicentre, magnitude and, optionally, the fault mechanism and rupture plane. Returns the scenario id and per-municipality damage and impact figures.

500.description: A pipeline output is missing on the server.

post.description: Buildings, residents and critical infrastructure inside MITECO's flood zone for one return period, in a circle (up to 200 km) or an administrative area.

500.description: A pipeline output is missing on the server.

get.description: Every QAFI v4 fault available to automatic mode, with its maximum magnitude, mechanism, seismogenic depth range and trace.

500.description: A pipeline output is missing on the server.

get.description: Automatic mode: the maximum-magnitude earthquake of one QAFI fault, rupturing its whole modelled plane. A GET, so the result is cacheable by URL. `near_lat`/`near_lon` only matter for a fault without rupture geometry (none in QAFI v4 today).

500.description: A pipeline output is missing on the server.

get.description: The vulnerability (taxonomy) and height class assigned to one cadastral building. Its footprint, floors, year and use are in the buildings vector tiles.

500.description: A pipeline output is missing on the server.

get.description: Which of a scenario's outputs are ready. Scenarios currently compute synchronously, so every flag is true once the scenario call has returned. Local server only.
The same per-municipality rows the scenario call returned. Local server only.

Impact figures for every affected INE census section, or only one municipality's with `municipality_code`. Earthquake rows carry damage counts and cost/debris estimates; flood rows carry buildings, residents and area in the flood zone.
Census section code to one number per section: the mean damage state (0 None to 4 Complete) for an earthquake, or the % of buildings in the flood zone for a flood.

Hospitals, schools, care homes, emergency services, power facilities, bridges and dams affected by the scenario, most intense first. For an earthquake: assets at estimated intensity VI or more, plus facilities whose building was damaged. For a flood: assets inside the flood zone.
Contours of estimated macroseismic intensity (EMS-98) as GeoJSON. Earthquake scenarios only.

get.summary: Get a buildings tile with scenario results
get.description: A Mapbox Vector Tile of building footprints, each carrying this scenario's damage state and probabilities when it has one. 204 for an empty tile. Served by a separate tiles function in the cloud deployment.
A Mapbox Vector Tile of the debris envelopes (the area around each damaged building that rubble may reach) for this scenario's damaged buildings.
Active incidents from the DGT, Servei Català de Trànsit and Trafikoa DATEX II feeds, as GeoJSON.

503.description: The upstream real-time feed is unavailable.

get.description: Each AEMET automatic station's latest hourly reading, as GeoJSON.

503.description: The upstream real-time feed is unavailable.

get.description: AEMET's current and upcoming Meteoalerta warnings, as GeoJSON polygons.

503.description: The upstream real-time feed is unavailable.

get.description: Loads data and compiled code ahead of the first scenario. The web app calls it on page load.

code.title: Code
code.description: INE code: 2 digits for a CCAA or province, 5 for a municipality.

taxonomy_source.title: Taxonomy Source
taxonomy_source.description: How the class was assigned (`heuristic_v2`: from construction year and floors).

DamageCounts.title: DamageCounts
DamageCounts.description: Buildings per damage state (the state reported at the chosen probability level).

scenario_id.title: Scenario Id
scenario_id.description: Content-addressed id: the same inputs always give the same id. Use it with the /results/{scenario_id}/... and /tiles/{scenario_id}/... routes.

municipality_stats.title: Municipality Stats
municipality_stats.description: Every municipality with at least one evaluated building.

infrastructure_summary.description: Null when no infrastructure data is deployed.

cached.title: Cached
cached.description: Whether the result came from the result cache.

Error.title: Error
Error.description: Local server shape. The AWS Lambda answers `{"error": "..."}` instead.

EvaluatedRegion.title: EvaluatedRegion
EvaluatedRegion.description:
The circle the scenario searched. Buildings outside it were not
evaluated, which is different from evaluated and undamaged.

mmax.title: Mmax
mmax.description: Maximum moment magnitude (Mw) used in automatic mode.

mmax_source.title: Mmax Source
mmax_source.description: Literature value published in QAFI, or estimated from trace length with Wells & Coppersmith (1994).

has_rupture_geometry.title: Has Rupture Geometry
has_rupture_geometry.description: Whether QAFI gives the dip and depth range needed for a finite rupture plane (true for every QAFI v4 fault).

geometry_geojson.title: Geometry Geojson
geometry_geojson.description: The fault trace as a GeoJSON (Multi)LineString, serialised as a string.

flooded_area_km2.title: Flooded Area Km2
flooded_area_km2.description: Flood-zone area inside the area (and circle).

unmapped_provinces.title: Unmapped Provinces
unmapped_provinces.description: Provinces in the region with no map at this return period (Canarias has no T10/T50). Not mapped is not the same as not flooded.

code.title: Code
code.description: INE code: 2 digits for a CCAA or province, 5 for a municipality.

region.title: Region
region.description: A circle, `{type: circle, lat, lon, radius_km}` with radius_km up to 200, or an administrative area, `{type: admin, level: ccaa | province | municipality, code}` with an INE code.

flooded_area_km2.title: Flooded Area Km2
flooded_area_km2.description: Flood-zone area inside the area (and circle).

intensity.title: Intensity
intensity.description: Estimated macroseismic intensity (EMS-98) at the asset. Earthquakes only.

damage_state_code.title: Damage State Code
damage_state_code.description: 0 None to 4 Complete, for facilities in an evaluated building; null otherwise. Earthquakes only.

damage_probs.title: Damage Probs
damage_probs.description: Probability of each damage state, None to Complete. Earthquakes only.

InfrastructureSummary.title: InfrastructureSummary
InfrastructureSummary.description: Affected assets per category. Categories with none are omitted.

cell_km.title: Cell Km
cell_km.description: Grid resolution the bands were contoured from.

IntensityBands.title: IntensityBands
IntensityBands.description:
GeoJSON FeatureCollection, one (Multi)Polygon per integer intensity
level from IV up, in `properties.intensity`.

ztor_km.title: Ztor Km
ztor_km.description: Depth to the top of the rupture, km. With strike, dip and ztor_km all given, the rupture is a finite plane sized from the magnitude (Wells & Coppersmith 1994); otherwise it's a point source.

probability_level.title: Probability Level
probability_level.description: `high`: median ground motion, most likely damage state. `low`: median + 1σ ground motion. `very_low`: median + 1σ and the 85th-percentile damage state.

lat.title: Lat
lat.description: Rupture point: the epicentre, or the fault trace's midpoint.

finite_rupture.title: Finite Rupture
finite_rupture.description: True when distances were measured to a finite rupture plane, false for the point-source approximation.

n_damaged.title: N Damaged
n_damaged.description: Evaluated buildings in any state other than None.

n_buildings.title: N Buildings
n_buildings.description: All buildings in the area, evaluated or not.

vulnerable_population.title: Vulnerable Population
vulnerable_population.description: Residents under 15 or aged 65 and over.

displaced_population.title: Displaced Population
displaced_population.description: Residents of Extensive or Complete buildings.

cost_meur.title: Cost Meur
cost_meur.description: Material repair cost, millions of euros.

truck_rotations.title: Truck Rotations
truck_rotations.description: 20-tonne truck trips to remove the debris.

n_damaged.title: N Damaged
n_damaged.description: Evaluated buildings in any state other than None.

n_buildings.title: N Buildings
n_buildings.description: All buildings in the area, evaluated or not.

vulnerable_population.title: Vulnerable Population
vulnerable_population.description: Residents under 15 or aged 65 and over.

displaced_population.title: Displaced Population
displaced_population.description: Residents of Extensive or Complete buildings.

cost_meur.title: Cost Meur
cost_meur.description: Material repair cost, millions of euros.

truck_rotations.title: Truck Rotations
truck_rotations.description: 20-tonne truck trips to remove the debris.

TrafficIncidents.title: TrafficIncidents
TrafficIncidents.description:
Point/line features with `source` (DGT, SCT, DT-GV), `category`,
`road`, `km_from`/`km_to`, `start_time`/`end_time` and more.

WeatherObservations.title: WeatherObservations
WeatherObservations.description:
One point per AEMET station: `ta` temperature (°C), `hr` humidity (%),
`prec` precipitation (mm), `vv`/`vmax` wind speed (m/s), `dv` wind
direction (°), `pres` pressure (hPa).

WeatherWarnings.title: WeatherWarnings
WeatherWarnings.description:
One polygon per warning zone: `level` (yellow, orange, red),
`phenomenon`, `event_es`/`event_en`, `onset`, `expires`.
